title: hypochondriac
desc_lfm_album: hypochondriac is brakence's second album, and his first since his signing to Columbia Records in 2021. The record was teased in the run-up to the presumed first single on Twitter, with the caption “bloomtodeath.” This led many listeners to believe the album would bare the same name. A week later, brakence teased what is believed to be the first single from the album, “argyle,” which was teased in an equally cryptic video posted on social media. The single was released on October 8, 2021. Two months would pass before brakence would announce another single called “cbd.” The track was released .
desc_lfm_artist: Randy Findell, better known as brakence, is a singer, songwriter, rapper, producer, and multi-instrumentalist from Columbus, OH. As a teenager, brakence began to produce his own music, and after dropping out of college, he began to focus solely on his music career. His music is lateral to the hyperpop and digicore scenes, while also blending styles of glitch pop, emo, electronic, and hip-hop. He released his label debut, "punk2", in March 2020, featuring the single "dropout".
